integrity: All-grid argument is analytic and self-contained in RESULT.md; the finite symbolic and rational tests in verify.py are supplementary rather than a proof of infinitely many cases.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly spaced real sampling nodes; nondecreasing real data; even integer exponent gamma at least two; degree-one local polynomial blending.
Strict monotonicity of the interpolant is not established.
The three-node constant was already known; new content is a simultaneous bound for every finite grid and strict larger-grid nonattainment.
Independent confirmation of historical priority is not available.
title: Three-node extremality for monotone-data overshoot in even-powered generalized Floater–Hormann interpolation
